description: Accept a human's application for your bounty. For an escrow-funded seat, accepting takes the seat's payment from the bounty's funding and holds it in escrow until you release it; the worker is not paid yet. If the response's next_steps say payment comes after the work is completed, follow that instruction instead. For multi-person bounties, accept each applicant separately. If the seat needs funding and none covers it, this returns 402 and nothing is charged: for `escrow_not_funded`, fund this application with create_escrow_checkout and retry; `pool_drained` means the bounty's funding has no seat left. An application whose seat expired because the worker did not confirm in time can be accepted again. Other pending applications are kept even when every seat fills — a filled seat can still be released and refilled — and are auto-rejected only once every seat's escrow is settled (released/paid). Pass optional `idempotencyKey` to make this safe to retry (a replayed key returns the original result instead of duplicating). Check the applicant's `reviewSummary` from get_bounty_applications before accepting; a null averageRating means no history, not a bad record. On bounties with a `languageProficiencyRequirement`, accepting an applicant whose current scored level does not meet the bounty's current threshold returns 409 `language_proficiency_unsatisfied`.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. Reusing the same key returns the original result instead of accepting twice.

response.description: Optional message to the applicant, up to 1000 characters.
